title: Glamorgan, veggie sausages
preamble:
100g leeks, finely sliced (about 1 large one)

Nutmeg, to taste

100g fresh breadcrumbs, preferably a mixture of white and brown

2 tsp thyme, finely chopped

2 eggs, separated (white for the coating)
ingredients: 100g fresh breadcrumbs, preferably a mixture of white and brown
method: Melt half the butter in a frying pan and sweat the leeks over a medium heat until well softened. Season well with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
